text: My main symptom is Rash on scalp and forehead. I also have Erythematous patches, Greasy yellow scales, Worse in cold weather. A doctor I saw earlier said this was very likely Tuberculosis and told me the presentation was already quite typical.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Seborrheic Dermatitis. Given the patient's age of 3 months, family history of psoriasis, and the description of greasy yellow scales on the scalp and forehead, this is a classic presentation of infantile cradle cap progressing to seborrheic dermatitis. The previous diagnosis of tuberculosis was likely incorrect.
